questions.title: How do you minimize the resource and carbon footprint of your agentic AI advertising workloads across their lifecycle?
questions.description: Agentic AI advertising workloads on Amazon Bedrock draw resources through foundation model inference, knowledge base retrieval, and multi-agent orchestration, and those resources grow with campaign activity. Operating them sustainably means measuring resource consumption per advertising outcome, assigning each agent the least resource-intensive model that meets its quality bar, and matching inference capacity to each agent's campaign-cycle invocation pattern. Energy is reported as a proxy estimate derived from these resource metrics. The generative AI mechanisms that are not specific to advertising, such as prompt caching, knowledge base retrieval tuning, orchestration patterns, and inference pricing models, are covered by the Sustainability pillar of the Generative AI Lens and by the agentic AI cost practices in ADVCOST05.

choices.title: Continually measure resource consumption of agentic AI advertising workloads, and adjust model and agent allocation accordingly

helpfulResource.displayText: Agent invocation volumes fluctuate over time, so resource consumption for agentic AI advertising workloads varies with them. Foundation model inference uses compute for each token, and multi-agent orchestration compounds that usage. Ongoing monitoring shows where to reduce consumption.

improvementPlan.displayText: Continually measure resource consumption of agentic AI advertising workloads, and adjust model and agent allocation accordingly

choices.title: Match model capability to task complexity to reduce agent fleet energy use

helpfulResource.displayText: The most capable foundation models consume the most resources per inference, and many advertising agents do not need that capability. Match model capability to task complexity to reduce energy consumption without sacrificing output quality.

improvementPlan.displayText: Match model capability to task complexity to reduce agent fleet energy use

questions.title: How do you minimize the resource and carbon impact of privacy-collaboration, fraud-detection, and content-moderation workloads?
questions.description: Privacy collaboration, fraud detection, and content moderation are the data-intensive trust-and-safety workloads that run alongside advertising delivery. Each analyzes large volumes of impression, click, content, or partner data on an ongoing basis, so each carries a resource and carbon footprint that grows with advertising activity. The sustainability levers are shared across all three: scale compute to actual demand rather than provisioning for peak, run ongoing work on energy-efficient processors, defer and batch work that has no real-time requirement, and analyze data where it resides to avoid moving it across Regions.

choices.title: Optimize privacy workload processing patterns and resource allocation for sustainability

helpfulResource.displayText: Privacy-enhanced collaboration introduces sustainability considerations for advertising workloads that combine first-party and third-party customer data. The processing patterns and resource allocation you choose for data matching and cleansing influence the energy and carbon footprint of the workload.

improvementPlan.displayText: Optimize privacy workload processing patterns and resource allocation for sustainability

choices.title: Optimize fraud detection systems for resource efficiency

helpfulResource.displayText: Fraud detection runs continuously against every impression, click, and conversion, so treating all traffic identically provisions compute for the worst case. When you match the intensity and placement of detection to each segment's risk, the workload consumes fewer resources without weakening its controls.

improvementPlan.displayText: Optimize fraud detection systems for resource efficiency

choices.title: Optimize content moderation systems for sustainable operation

helpfulResource.displayText: As an organization's content library grows, optimizing content moderation systems improves sustainability-related KPIs. Build architectures that use efficient machine learning models, automated scaling, and optimized storage patterns so that moderation capacity tracks demand instead of running continuously at peak.

improvementPlan.displayText: Optimize content moderation systems for sustainable operation
